instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically save files after a 1000 millisecond delay.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to enable auto-save with 1000ms delay. Evaluator checks settings.json for files.autoSave='afterDelay' and files.autoSaveDelay=1000. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VS Code settings file at /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json - this is the correct location for user settings
Metric function check_json_settings properly handles type='rule' expected values by accessing expected['expected'] to get the rules dictionary
Complete coverage: Both required settings are verified - files.autoSave='afterDelay' (enables auto-save mode) and files.autoSaveDelay=1000 (sets delay)
Expected values are semantically correct for the instruction requirements
Metric correctly compares using exact equality (line 74 in vscode.py), which is appropriate for configuration settings
Robust error handling: Returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist or JSON parsing fails; uses sentinel object to distinguish missing keys from None values
No postconfig needed: VS Code settings persist to disk automatically
Logic will work correctly at runtime
